key_catalyst: IBM's earnings warning triggers software stock selloff as enterprise spending rotates to AI infrastructure
reasoning: IBM's warning about enterprise capex shifting to AI infrastructure triggered a sector-wide selloff in traditional software stocks (ServiceNow -5%, Adobe -4.3%) that dragged QQQ down 0.96% even as the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.90%. This rotation is novel and escalating, while hawkish Fed commentary and elevated oil prices add to overnight gap-down risk.
